obligations.name: Hypotheses
obligations.required_input: A natural transformation of actual commutative-group presheaves.
obligations.constructed_input: The generic helper takes precisely F ⟶ G; the application uses FifthSheafNorm318.norm.hom.
obligations.justification: No extra freeness or global triviality is assumed.

obligations.name: Objects
obligations.required_input: Source units must live on inverse images of actual target overlaps.
obligations.constructed_input: SourceCocycle U uses the actual pushedUnits map, and TargetCocycle U the actual Target units.
obligations.justification: No related field or surrogate scheme replaces these section rings.

obligations.name: Coverage
obligations.required_input: All ordered double and triple intersections, including empty ones.
obligations.constructed_input: Cocycle quantifies over every i,j,k in any index type.
obligations.justification: These identities apply to any open family. Cover and source-trivialization existence are separate inputs, not proved for arbitrary source lines.

obligations.name: Maps
obligations.required_input: Restrictions, norm and changes of frame must have the correct directions.
obligations.constructed_input: restrict maps W-sections to V-sections for V≤W; triple uses (Ui∩Uj)∩Uk. Transfer applies the actual norm on whole double intersections.
obligations.justification: Evaluated naturality and multiplicativity prove the three restriction identities, without generic-point extension.

obligations.name: Coefficients
obligations.constructed_input: pullback_transition is precisely the eighth power of each original target unit.
obligations.justification: FifthOpenNorm318.unit_pullback binds the actual generic pullback degree eight. No normalization is silently dropped.

obligations.name: Identities
obligations.required_input: Transport the actual coboundary convention and the whole cocycle.
obligations.constructed_input: A coboundary is restricted a_i times inverse of restricted a_j. The target gauge uses the actual norms of source units.
obligations.justification: map_coboundary and gaugeEquivalent prove that convention; pullback_transfer proves equality of entire cocycle structures by transition equality.

obligations.name: Local/global
obligations.required_input: Whole-overlap cocycle compatibility rather than pointwise identities.
obligations.constructed_input: The generic map constructs all diagonal and triple equations in the actual presheaf.
obligations.justification: The all-open norm supplies actual naturality including empty opens; this packet does not assume global source triviality.

obligations.name: Evidence
obligations.required_input: Final sources must strictly check with private-inclusive recursive axiom coverage.
obligations.constructed_input: check-3.log passes both final modules; audit.log checks all42 declarations from exactly those modules and eight endpoints.
obligations.justification: check-1 is an earlier generic version; check-2 retains an intermediate failed use of unitNorm instead of its app. Neither is called final validation.

obligations.name: Boundary
obligations.required_input: Separate author proof evidence from independent acceptance and Picard construction.
obligations.constructed_input: This author packet proves transition/coboundary transfer for specified target-pullback open data.
obligations.justification: It does not construct arbitrary source trivializations, a Picard quotient, line-bundle descent, Jacobian, polarization or PEL structure. Review and hosted integration remain pending.
